funding.name: Oregon Promise Grant
funding.provides: A state grant that helps cover tuition at any Oregon community college for recent high school and GED graduates.
funding.eligibility: Oregon resident for at least 12 months before college attendance; must begin community college no more than six months after high school or GED completion; students with a Student Aid Index of $27,000 or more are not eligible (per the program updates page); applies to students who graduate July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027 for the current cycle.
funding.how_to_apply: Apply in the OSAC Student Portal during senior year or immediately after GED completion; file the FAFSA or ORSAA and list an Oregon community college; deadlines vary by graduation date.

funding.name: Oregon Promise Grant program updates
funding.provides: Program update notice stating that students who graduated before June 30, 2026 missed the deadline and that students graduating July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027 can apply starting in October 2026.
funding.eligibility: Students with a Student Aid Index of $27,000 or more are not eligible (per page).
funding.how_to_apply: Apply via the OSAC Student Portal; FAFSA or ORSAA required.
